channel.title: Space Bulletin Weekly
channel.description: Space Bulletin Weekly is a roughly five-minute roundup of the week's most important space news, published every Saturday morning. Each edition covers NASA and the Artemis program, SpaceX, Earth observation, major space deals and funding, and space-tech startups. Read by an AI-voiced newsreader (synthetic voice); stories are researched from published sources and checked by an AI assistant.

item.title: Space Bulletin Daily – Wednesday, October 14, 2026
item.description: NASA says work on the rocket for Artemis Three has reached another milestone. According to the agency, teams at Kennedy Space Center in Florida have finished stacking the final solid rocket booster segments on the mobile launcher, and all four RS-25 engines are now installed on the core stage. NASA plans to roll the partial rocket out to Launch Pad 39B in the coming months for a fueling test.
